title: Hessdalen Lights: Norway’s Never‑Ending Glow

scenes.text: Since 1981, blue‑white balls appear nightly in a Norwegian valley
Phenomenon occurs in the Hessdalen valley, near Holtålen, Trøndelag, Norway
Scientists recorded over 1 000 events using a dedicated research station
Image of a Hessdalen light captured by the research team in 1995

scenes.label: MYSTERY LIGHT
scenes.sub: Explanations range from ionized dust to unknown plasma phenomena

scenes.text: Follow for the cases no one can explain.

description: The Hessdalen lights have puzzled researchers for four decades, with no consensus on their origin. Dive deeper with us.
